findings.name: Disable Telnet on VTY Lines
findings.description: Telnet transmits credentials and payload in cleartext. Only SSH must be accepted.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
line vty 0 15
transport input ssh
findings.details: VTY lines strictly restricted to encrypted SSH connections.

findings.name: Enforce Strong Enable Secret
findings.description: Legacy 'enable password' is vulnerable to rainbow table attacks. Use 'enable secret' (Type 5/8/9).
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
no enable password
enable secret <STRONG_PASSWORD>
findings.details: Strong cryptographic hash used for privileged EXEC access.

findings.name: Enable Local Password Encryption
findings.description: Service password-encryption hides cleartext strings in the running configuration.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
service password-encryption

findings.name: Enforce SSH Version 2
findings.description: SSH Version 1 suffers from known cryptographic flaws (CRC-32 compensation attack).
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
ip ssh version 2

findings.name: Enable AAA New-Model Authentication
findings.description: AAA new-model provides standardized authentication, authorization, and accounting controls.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local

findings.name: Configure Legal Login Banner (MOTD)
findings.description: A legal warning banner is required for legal enforcement against unauthorized access.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
banner motd ^C AUTHORIZED ACCESS ONLY ^C

findings.name: Configure Centralized NTP Synchronization
findings.description: Synchronized clocks are essential for accurate incident response and forensic log correlation.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
ntp server 192.168.10.254

findings.name: Configure Centralized Remote Syslog
findings.description: Log buffers fill quickly; events must be forwarded offsite to a SIEM/Syslog server.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
logging host <SYSLOG_IP>
logging trap warnings

findings.name: Avoid Default VLAN 1 for User Traffic
findings.description: VLAN 1 is the default native VLAN and a common target for VLAN hopping / STP manipulation.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
interface <INT>
switchport access vlan <VLAN_ID>
findings.details: Interfaces assigned to default VLAN 1. Segregate traffic.

findings.name: Implement Switchport Port-Security
findings.description: Port-Security mitigates MAC-flooding and rogue device attachment on access ports.
findings.remediation:
configure terminal
interface <INT>
switchport port-security
switchport port-security violation shutdown
findings.details: MAC address limiters and violation actions configured.
